Subject: Request: on-prem / air-gapped architecture deep-dive and kickoff

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Greenleaf is ready to move forward with a private on-prem deployment evaluation — our security and infra teams want a technical deep-dive that covers VPC isolation patterns, air-gapped build & patch processes, and evidence we can use for our internal auditors.

High-level asks we want covered:
- End-to-end networking (bastion, egress controls, allowed outbound endpoints)
- Data handling: disk encryption, KMS integration, logging and retention
- Build and update workflow for air-gapped sites (signed artifacts, transfer process)
- Required artifacts for our compliance team (SOC2-style evidence, audit logs)
- Expected throughput and sizing guidance for a 4–8 node inference cluster (batching and latency SLOs)

Can your team do a 60–90 minute session next week? We prefer mornings CET (08:00–12:00) — I'm copying our security lead so they can confirm availability. Also attaching a simple network diagram and our compliance checklist.

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Director, IT Operations
Greenleaf Bio

2) Network boundary & connectivity options (bastion, egress proxies) (20m)
3) Build/airgap/patch workflow (20m)
4) Compliance artifacts & logging approach (15m)

I've looped in Diego (networking) and Monica (deploy/runbook) who will lead different agenda sections. If any other engineers should be present, please add them; otherwise Marco is welcome to join as well.
